verdict.rationale: Square's Payments API 'Take Payments' docs list several payment types alongside card payments: ACH Bank Transfer, Afterpay/Clearpay (BNPL) and Cash App Payments (a wallet). The Web Payments SDK is also documented, which suggests one integration surface covers several methods. The evidence consists only of doc link titles, though, and never names Apple Pay or Google Pay. missing for 10: explicit Apple Pay/Google Pay support, documentation confirming all methods work through a single integration, depth beyond link titles on bank redirects and local methods, independent or hands-on corroboration.
